name: Stage 0 - Master Pipeline (Discover -> Research -> Write -> QA -> Photo -> Publish)

parameters.content:
## Master Pipeline: Discover -> Research -> Write -> QA -> Photo -> Publish

Give it a category. It finds N unique real products (SearXNG + DeepSeek), then loops each one through the full Stage 2 research+writer+QA chain, sources a CC-licensed photo (Openverse), and publishes an approved review straight into WordPress via the rgh/v1/publish-review ingest endpoint. A product that fails research-trust, validation, or QA is skipped (not published) and the loop continues to the next product.

Requires: SearXNG at http://searxng:8080, a DeepSeek API key (DEEP_SEEK_API_KEY env var, model: deepseek-flash), WordPress reachable at http://wordpress (docker network) with the rgh-ingest-api mu-plugin installed.
